support_claim: Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party, and the notes instruct treating the registry link as unresolved despite shared naming between billing and the MSA.
justification: The packet preserves multiple live registry candidates (including a Wyoming LLC) and explicitly states that legal has not determined the contracting party; although billing and the MSA counterparty share the name Northbridge Analytics Inc., name alignment alone does not establish identity under the relation contract, and no observation establishes that the billing referent and the MSA counterparty are distinct entities.
